source.name: NYC DOB NOW: Build job filings (new buildings, demolitions, alterations)
source.describes: construction of a job started (first permit issued) here
source.license: NYC Open Data terms of use

traps.detail: First permit marks the start of work; certificates of occupancy mark completion, years later.
Jobs filed in DOB NOW only; most new buildings since 2021, but projects filed earlier in the legacy system are missing.
Coordinates are geocoded to the street frontage; match lots by BBL or with polygon_match = nearest.
Only outcomes from 2021-01-01 on, after the prediction date 2021-01-01.
3,346 records fell outside every prediction feature.
789 records matched by ID and 231 by location; 3,346 matched nothing (outside the study area or without an ID or nearby feature).
272 features had no prediction, no outcome, or fewer than 1 records.
